display_totals.calculated_total_label_rule: Calculated Total must never be labelled Certified Total

qa_rules.VAL-090: Assurance buckets remain segregated; terminal statuses have null numeric totals and are never mixed into compliant numeric totals.
qa_rules.VAL-091: Every source E07 assurance record reconciles to exactly one aggregate bucket at each applicable hierarchy level; project-level source counts equal E07 source counts.

null_policy: No source numeric result means null aggregate numeric result for that status/component bucket; never emit placeholder zero.
